title: Space used by an added tape
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over an alphabet $\Gamma$ with no work tapes, and let $x$ be any input word. For every time $t\in\mathbb N$, the machine obtained by adding one blank, stationary work tape uses exactly one work-tape cell by time $t$.
